Its seventeen hypotheses in order are the conjunction of PartI, N1ab, N1c, and the statement that for every type E with Field E, NumberField E, and IsCMField E, every H of type Host E, and every D of type Datum H, both ToroidalLevelCompatibility and ToroidalHeckeCompatibility hold for D, followed by KeyFormula, GlobalTheory.Published.SemiAbelianHomExtension, GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.NumbersDVR.NumericalSegre.Statement, ReciprocityTheory.ChartRestriction.G.Geo.ResK.ResKStatement, HT.FarguesHodgeTate, Flat.GagaSections, GroundTheory.Heights₂.Heights.LineOfLargeDegree.Statement, PB.Inputs, Prov.HS, Prov.An, Prov.ZhangDimensionPushDownGrassmannianHeightBounds, ReciprocityTheory.ChartRestriction.G.Geo.PtsIntegrableStatement, ReciprocityTheory.ChartRestriction.G.AI.I2.AvoidStatement, GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.GR.QuotientByFiniteFlatStatement, GlobalTheory.CompanionTheory.Ar.GR.ZarhinStatement, and ThetaUnifAV.
